'''Gusepp's Hand''' was the mummified hand of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] tyrant [[Gusepp]]. Severed by the [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]] [[Iunist]], it became a valuable artifact, valued at 60,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. During the period of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it was owned by the [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]] [[Gallo Memm]].
